build_OHEMSampler: build an OHEMSampler instance with num, pos_fraction, and context for online hard example mining
review_OHEMSampler_hard_mining: review the OHEMSampler hard_mining method to select top-k highest loss samples from bboxes
refactor_OHEMSampler_sample_pos: refactor the OHEMSampler _sample_pos method to sample hard positive bounding box proposals
test_OHEMSampler_sample_neg: test the OHEMSampler _sample_neg method to sample hard negative bounding box proposals
summarize_OHEMSampler_init: summarize the OHEMSampler __init__ to configure bbox_head from context for single or multi-stage detectors
